notes: ACCESS: direct fetch (probe.py / requests) worked on every URL, HTTP 200 throughout, no blocking, no proxy needed - matches the prior Home-Decor pass note. TREE: taken from the rendered mega-menu in the homepage HTML (data-nav-column-id="main-menu-2025,"), which lists 10 departments (new-featured, garden, furniture, accessories, kitchen-dining, bedroom, bathroom, hardware, lighting, last-chance). Furniture dept children: All / Sofas / Armchairs / Tables / Chairs & Benches / Storage & Shelving / Footstools / Beds / Outdoor Furniture (-> /collections/garden-furniture) / Available Now. Garden dept: All / Garden Furniture / Garden Seating / Garden Tables / Garden Cushions / Garden Accessories / Potting & Planting / Outdoor Lighting. Kitchen & Dining dept: ... / Dining Furniture / Kitchen Storage. Bedroom dept: All / Bedlinen & Textiles / Beds / Bedroom Furniture. Bathroom dept has NO furniture node (only Bathroom Fittings, Bathroom Mirrors, Bathroom Accessories, Bathroom Textiles) - checked explicitly for vanity/cabinet units, none exist. The tree is only two levels deep: I re-fetched several leaf collection pages (sofas, furniture) and the only /collections/ hrefs on them are the same global nav, so no third level exists and no leaf hides children. QTY METHOD: every count is the rendered listing header, literally ' N products ' present in the served HTML (this theme is NOT Klevu-hydrated for these collections, unlike the lighting collections flagged in the prior pass, so the static header is the live header). CROSS-CHECK: I independently enumerated /collections//products.json?limit=250 for all 14 candidate collections and the product counts matched the rendered header EXACTLY in all 14 cases (sofas 30, armchairs 33, tables 16, chairs-benches 13, storage-shelving 20, footstools 20, beds 9, garden-furniture 30, garden-seating 16, garden-tables 6, dining-furniture 12, bedroom-furniture 14, kitchen-storage 13, all-furniture 130). Counts differ per collection (no site-wide constant), and the h1 of every page matched the requested node. HIERARCHY DECISION - Outdoor Furniture: /collections/garden-furniture (30) is the same URL behind both 'Outdoor Furniture' (Furniture menu) and 'Garden Furniture' (Garden menu). By product IDs it is a content superset: Garden Tables 6/6 and Garden Seating 15/16 of its items sit inside it, and its 9 remaining items are 3 Harmen outdoor stools, 2 Polperro parasols and 4 outdoor seat cushions - i.e. a mixed roll-up. So it is emitted as a GROUPING row and the two deeper, clean nodes (Garden Seating 16, Garden Tables 6) carry the qty, per the deepest-node rule. The 3 outdoor stools are therefore not represented by any leaf; noted here deliberately rather than double-counting a 30-item superset. OVERLAP (documented, both kept): 'Dining Furniture' (12) is a room re-cut whose 12 products are all already inside Tables (4), Chairs & Benches (6) and Storage & Shelving (2 - Ivel Oak Dresser/Sideboard); 'Bedroom Furniture' (14) likewise sits 9/14 inside Storage & Shelving with the rest in Tables/Footstools/Chairs & Benches (its one non-furniture item is the Elodie Dressing Table Mirror). Both are genuine, separately-named nav nodes in different departments with their own exact site counts, so both are emitted and flagged, mirroring the Mirrors / Bathroom Mirrors treatment in the prior pass. EXCLUDED and why: 'All' roll-ups (all-furniture 130, all-garden, all-bedroom, all-kitchen-dining, all-bathroom, all-accessories, all-lighting, all-hardware) - Shop-All navigation per rule 3; 'Available Now' (14) and 'Freshly In Stock' - availability filters, not categories; Last Chance / Gently Imperfect and their last-chance-furniture child - clearance/outlet per rule 3; the marketing collections (An Ode To Oak, The Sorrel Collection, The Wilbur Collection, Our British Upholstery Collection, Our Christmas Collection, Spring/Summer 2026, Al Fresco Entertaining, Gather & Dine, To Give To Gift, Our Antique Brass Edit, Summer Accessories, Handmade Ceramics) - promotional/material edits; 'Kitchen Storage' (13) - inspected all 13 titles and it is a mixed roll-up that is majority NOT furniture (2 stoneware storage jars, 3 brass hanging/hook rails, plus 2 wall shelves/racks) and every one of its 6 genuinely furniture items (Odette Oak Bookshelf, Ivel Oak Dresser, Ivel Oak Sideboard, Everett Oak Console Table, Stanton Oak Drinks Trolley, Odin Brass Drinks Trolley) is already inside Storage & Shelving or Tables, so the node was dropped whole; Garden Cushions / Garden Accessories / Potting & Planting / Outdoor Lighting (textiles, decor, lighting); Bedlinen & Textiles, Cushions & Blankets, Rugs, Table Linen, Bathroom Textiles (textiles); Tableware, Glassware, Handmade Ceramics (tabletop); Lighting dept in full, Mirrors and Bathroom Mirrors (Wall Decor's job); Decorative Accessories, Candlelight (decor); Hardware dept (Knobs & Handles, Latches, Interior Door Handles, Front Door, Hooks & Rails); Bathroom Fittings and Bathroom Accessories (fixtures/hardware).
